title: F1Telemetry Metric4 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f1telemetry:metric4
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day f1telemetry metric4 (4) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on f1telemetry metric4 (4) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly what time of day your f1telemetry metric4 (4) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
